rca_of_issue: Original bug: window.print() footer showed page URL (emergent.sh) in exported PDF. Root cause: default @page margins leave room for the browser's automatic header/footer (URL, title, date). Fix by dev: set `@page { margin: 0; size: A4 }` in both report HTML strings (single in result/[id].tsx, combined in pdf-report.ts) and compensate content padding on body/.page/.cover. Also added <title>KHT Report/KHT Combined Report so if any print engine still displays a title it is branded, not the app URL. Additionally moved Result-screen web printing to the shared printHtmlOnWeb() helper (hidden iframe) so it doesn't print the app DOM. Verified via headless Chromium: captured iframe HTML contains the expected @page rule/title, no emergent.sh, no http(s) text outside data URIs, badges use CLEAR/TARNISH, cover stats use Clear/Tarnish. Also confirmed the HTML renders to a valid PDF (333KB) via page.pdf(prefer_css_page_size=True, display_header_footer=False).
